name: @mockasort-studio/pi-automata-crew
description: Dispatch role-based agents from Pi: each runs in its own VM, work lands as draft pull requests that must pass CI.

scripts.test: env -u PI_SDK_ACTOR_ID -u PI_CREW_WORKER_CONFIG -u PI_CREW_COMM_TOKEN -u PI_CREW_ROOT -u PI_SESSION_ID npm run test:suite
scripts.test:suite: node --test tests/crew/*.test.mjs tests/runtime/*.test.mjs tests/pi/*.test.mjs && bash tests/pi/test-extension-load.sh
scripts.format: prettier --write extensions tests scripts docs README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check extensions tests scripts docs README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md
